propositions: The system currently lacks an AST-based ownership guard to enforce centralized composition access; legacy ambient reads can bypass the approved seams.

A new deterministic static analysis gate (check_config_ownership.py) must reject unapproved direct environment access, backend property reload, and credential reads outside registered seam boundaries.
Ownership registry, generated documentation (config/security lifecycle), and CI integration must be in place and passing before legacy facades and migration exceptions are removed.
Behavioral regression suites from prior work (S1-S6) remain the correctness oracle; the AST gate is a change detector that supplements rather than replaces runtime validation.
Bounded provider, AWS review-bot, and reconciler live canaries must pass with redacted evidence before legacy removal is finalized; rollback strategy retains S1 snapshot-envelope compatibility floor.
